title: HeardMuffledPayload
description: A voice the Body heard through a wall (decision 0199, MH-1): a muffled notice with a direction (a compass point, or overhead or below for a voice straight above or below) and a distance band. The plugin sends it on geldar.<shard>.body.<life_id>.hearing. It never carries coordinates, a speaker or words, and it does not wake the Mind. The schema rejects x, y, z and every other field.

direction.description: World-fixed direction of the voice: n is -z, s is +z, e is +x, w is -x; one of the eight compass points. "overhead" or "below" is used when the horizontal offset between speaker and listener is under 1 block (dx and dz both below 1 in absolute value): "overhead" when the speaker is level with or above the listener (dy >= 0, dy being the speaker's y minus the listener's y), "below" when under. Neither states a horizontal direction.

band.description: Distance band of the voice: bands as heard_sound, except far runs to 32. Near is up to 8 blocks, mid up to 16.
